verdict.rationale: Kushki's own docs list recurring charges ('Crea un cargo recurrente') and scheduled-charge management ('Maneja tus cargos calendarizados'). That is a first-party recurring schedule, not a one-off action, but it is limited to payment charges rather than general jobs or workflows, and the evidence is title-only. Missing for 10: scheduling of arbitrary jobs/workflows beyond card charges, documented schedule configuration (intervals, cron-like rules, API fields), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
